description: Cameron is pulled into Oz’s eccentric Contra Security crew, where elaborate penetration tests, office rivalries and Cameron’s feelings for Melanie turn every supposedly professional job into controlled chaos.

s01e01.description: Contra Security owner Oz blackmails gifted hacker Cameron into joining his eccentric team, where breaking sophisticated systems proves easier than surviving his new coworkers.

s01e02.description: The team expects an easy home-security job until an elderly target’s defenses prove formidable, while Cameron attracts the attention of a dentist.

s01e03.description: A security leak at a racetrack forces Cameron to recruit car enthusiast Dutch while Cash becomes convinced the office copier has come alive.

s01e04.description: Contra is hired to protect the only copy of a major movie sequel at a comic convention, and suspicion falls on fanboy Cash when it disappears.

s01e05.description: Melanie is delighted when her ex-con father returns just as Contra is hired to test the security around a priceless museum painting.

s01e06.description: After a failed assignment, Oz traps the team inside Contra for a weekend exercise that forces them to work together and exposes Cameron’s feelings for Melanie.

s01e07.description: A job identifying a teenage cyber-bully sends Cameron back to his old high school and straight into the embarrassments he hoped to leave behind.
